title: Compose and index durable provider process observations
description: Prerequisite for task-ded026d6587442eabc28ff2609d231aa. Current measurement at HEAD a42ae2f: safe_boundary.observe is envelope-reachable, but there is no system-runner/host observation source a handler can trust. The existing production pieces `launchActivationProviderRun` -> `commitActivationProviderRun` -> `commitProviderRunRecord` correctly bind the physical launcher handoff and ProviderRunRef(attempt/effect/run/epoch), yet have zero non-test call sites and no strict reader selecting the run by attemptRef. FoundationAttemptRecorded drops exit state, and activation PROCESS_OBSERVED is registration rather than termination. Deliverable: compose the existing physical launch/commit chain at the real dispatch/reconciliation boundary and expose a decision-verified current provider-run observation reader by project+attempt. Consumer: task-ded026d6587442eabc28ff2609d231aa.
definitionOfDone: A production dispatch/reconciliation call site invokes exactly `launchActivationProviderRun` and then `commitActivationProviderRun`; the persisted ProviderRunRecord comes from the real launcher handoff, never from a safe_boundary.observe payload or a locally rebuilt observation.

The committed record retains the exact ProviderRunRef attemptRef/effectIntentId/runRef/epoch plus launcher exit/reconciliation truth, and is decision-backed to the authenticated project/session identity; a caller cannot select or rewrite any of those facts.

A strict current reader selects by projectId and attemptRef using an index-backed bounded scan, verifies command receipt/decision identity and canonical bytes, and returns exactly one record; ABSENT, UNREADABLE, MALFORMED, AMBIGUOUS and BINDING_MISMATCH have distinct stable codes and exact layers.

Real-Sqlite tests drive the production physical-boundary composition, cover one accepted observed-exit control plus unobserved, vanished, unreadable, duplicate, foreign-project and conflicting replay cases, and assert exact code/layer, zero partial residue, raw counts, and nonzero generated cases.
Exact replay returns the original record without a second physical launch or append; conflicting command bytes refuse before launch/commit and leave the original bytes unchanged.

Completion names task-ded026d6587442eabc28ff2609d231aa as consumer and records its exact reader call site; daemon typecheck/test and the existing plain-Node provider construction test execute with nonzero test evidence.
taskRails: Compose the existing public runner/daemon launch and provider-run ledger surfaces; do not add a wire kind, reimplement process observation, infer exit from FoundationAttemptRecorded, or treat PROCESS_OBSERVED registration as termination.
Only the physical launcher/reconciliation boundary may supply exit facts. Caller payloads may identify no run, exit, reconciliation, observation ref, or safe flag.
Verify every cross-package manifest/lock/bare-import edge before naming it; preserve upstream runner/ledger refusal code and layer rather than restamping.
Use real SqliteEventStore, TDD exact codes/layers, bounded index reads, target <=250 lines per production source, and explicit owned-path commits.

implementationPlan.description: BASELINE AND PROVE EVERY LANDED EDGE BEFORE EDITING. Record HEAD, merge-base, and `git status --short` for the three owned paths; require them clean. Re-measure `foundation-attempt-service.ts` at 248 physical lines and confirm the six prerequisite surfaces on disk: `createFoundationLauncherAuthority`, `launchActivationProviderRun`, `commitActivationProviderRun`, and `readCurrentProviderRun`, plus the exported provider-run identity/command constants. Verify `apps/daemon/package.json` declares `@moe/runner` and `@moe/store`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` has both daemon importer links, and a temporary source inside `apps/daemon` can typecheck bare imports of `createTelemetryBoundClaudeLauncher`, `discoverInstalledClaudeRuntime`, and `SqliteEventStore`; run a bogus-symbol TS2305 negative control and delete the probe/config in the same PowerShell `try/finally`. Capture each baseline leg separately: daemon typecheck; the five focused production suites for Foundation service, Windows, telemetry adapter, provider commit, and provider reader (currently 5 files / 147 tests); and full daemon test. Record every count line and foreign failure path rather than treating exit 0 or a zero-test filter as evidence.

TDD RED — PORTABLE COMPOSITION, IDENTITY, AND CALLER-AUTHORITY FENCE in `foundation-attempt-service.test.ts`, over a real file-backed `SqliteEventStore`. Extend the existing forced-`platform:"linux"` dispatch: Foundation must keep the raw launcher refusal `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED` at `LAUNCHER`, while `readCurrentProviderRun(store,{projectId,attemptRef:"attempt-1"})` accepts exactly one honest blind provider record. Pin the durable `ProviderRunRef` exactly to `{provider:"claude",runRef:deriveDispatchAggregateId(activationAggregateId),effectIntentId:"intent-1",attemptRef:"attempt-1",epoch:3}`, the returned session to the lease `ownerSessionRef` (deliberately different from the activation principal), launch `REFUSED`, terminal `REFUSED`, infrastructure `LAUNCH_REFUSED`, upstream `TELEMETRY_LAUNCH_REFUSED@TELEMETRY_LAUNCH`, null daemon clock observations, one provider event, and one `provider-run.telemetry.commit` decision whose project and principal are the durable project and lease session. Use transparent partial wrappers that call the REAL telemetry adapter and commit function, capture exact input/result identities, and never fabricate a launcher result, handoff, authority, exit, or clock; assert one adapter call, one commit call, and that the commit receives the adapter's exact bound result object. Add a hand-pinned, nonempty generated request-smuggling sweep for `providerRun`, `runRef`, exit/reconciliation/terminal/infrastructure, observation/safe-boundary, launcher, and dependency fields; every arm must refuse `FOUNDATION_ATTEMPT_REQUEST_MALFORMED@DAEMON_FOUNDATION_ATTEMPT` before either wrapper and leave raw events/decisions unchanged.

TDD RED — REPLAY, CONFLICT, AND PRE-COMMIT FAILURE in the same real-SQLite service suite. After the first production dispatch, snapshot the provider record/digest/canonical bytes, provider event count, provider decision, whole-store event horizon, raw event count, and raw decision count. Exact replay of the same request must return the original Foundation record, keep every snapshot byte/count unchanged, and leave the transparent adapter/commit totals at one. A materially changed `cwd` or other identity-covered command byte under the same dispatch aggregate must refuse `FOUNDATION_ATTEMPT_REPLAY_MISMATCH@DAEMON_FOUNDATION_ATTEMPT` before adapter or provider commit, preserving the original provider bytes/digest. Reuse the existing real-store aborting wrapper at provider commit ordinal 4: assert `PROVIDER_RUN_STORE_UNAVAILABLE@PROVIDER_RUN_LEDGER` (and the exact storeCode shape production returns), zero provider event/decision residue, no false reader authority, and no second physical attempt. Querying the accepted record under a foreign project must preserve `PROVIDER_RUN_BINDING_MISMATCH@PROVIDER_RUN_READER` and change no counts. Do not duplicate the landed 64-case reader matrix: explicitly retain its real-SQLite ABSENT, RECORD_UNREADABLE, EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE, cross-page AMBIGUOUS, foreign binding, bounded-scan, positive generated-count, and zero-write assertions as prerequisite coverage run in the final focused gate.

TDD RED — ONE REAL OBSERVED PHYSICAL CONTROL in `foundation-attempt-windows.test.ts`. Replace the stale premise that no production quote can be minted: call public zero-input `discoverInstalledClaudeRuntime()` and, on Windows, fail explicitly unless it returns the PROVEN installed observation/root (do not dynamically skip a missing current prerequisite). Build the Foundation runtime request from that exact observation plus an attempt-owned scratch pin root, and drive the shipped broker through the harmless installed-Claude `--version` argv using the real service and real SQLite. Through `readCurrentProviderRun`, assert an accepted frozen record with the exact durable ref/session/digest, `record.launch.kind === "OBSERVED"`, `record.launch.exit.kind === "EXITED"`, and exit code 0; do not mislabel version output as a completed provider result. Pin one delegated telemetry-adapter call, one provider event/decision, and the activation transition/pin evidence proving the control reached the physical boundary. Replay the same bytes and then conflict one identity-covered byte: replay appends/launches zero and returns original bytes, while conflict is the exact prelaunch Foundation replay mismatch. Keep existing hostile self-assembled quote/reservation cases with their exact code and layer. Close every store and process handle before Windows temp cleanup.

GREEN — REPLACE THE RAW FOUNDATION LAUNCH BLOCK, DO NOT ADD A PARALLEL PATH. In `foundation-attempt-service.ts`, after the RESERVED decision wins and before observation settlement, construct `createFoundationLauncherAuthority` from the verified activation aggregate, `bound.correlationId`, `activation.decision.key`, its durable project, and the real store. Derive only server-owned provider facts: `providerCommandId = `${bound.target}:provider-run``, and `ProviderRunRef = {provider:"claude",runRef:bound.target,effectIntentId:record.effectIntent.intentId,attemptRef:record.attempt.attemptId,epoch:record.lease.epoch}`. Invoke `launchActivationProviderRun(authority,{providerRun,request:launchRequestBody(...),options:narrowLaunchOptions(...)})` exactly once and keep its exact `ClaudeBoundLaunchResult`; never pass it through `snapshotFoundationValue` or reconstruct its result/handoff. Immediately call `commitActivationProviderRun` once with that same object, key `{commandId:providerCommandId,principalId:record.lease.ownerSessionRef,projectId:activation.decision.key.projectId}`, correlationId `providerCommandId`, decidedAt `activation.decision.decidedAt`, canonical `identity.bytes`, and `{observedStart:null,observedEnd:null}` (there is no daemon boot/monotonic observation to invent), with no usage priors. Preserve any adapter/ledger refusal's exact code/layer through the existing UNPROVEN settle; after a successful provider commit, reuse `launched.result` unchanged for `readDurableFoundationObservation`. Keep the reservation replay/conflict short-circuit before authority/adapter creation; do not production-call the strict reader merely to ignore it — task-ded026d6587442eabc28ff2609d231aa is the named consumer and will call `readCurrentProviderRun(store,{projectId,attemptRef})`. Remove/compact stale raw-launch containment prose and blank lines so this focused production file remains <=250 physical lines; do not edit the DONE adapter, ledger, reader, schemas, wire kinds, or add a fourth helper file.

ADVERSARIAL REVIEW AND MUTATION DRILLS, each applied to the production service alone, with the exact edited range recorded, the mutation confirmed present, one named intended assertion red, and byte/hash restoration before the next (never `git checkout`, reset, or broad restore in the shared tree). Drill: (1) use envelope `principalId` instead of durable `lease.ownerSessionRef` — the integrated accepted reader test must red specifically on `PROVIDER_RUN_BINDING_MISMATCH@PROVIDER_RUN_READER`; (2) bypass provider commit or return to the raw launcher — the provider accepted/event-count test must red rather than merely return a different refusal; (3) move the replay short-circuit below the adapter or invoke the adapter twice — the replay one-call/unchanged-count assertion must red; (4) settle Foundation from the handoff telemetry refusal instead of the untouched raw `.result` — the Linux test must red on loss of `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED@LAUNCHER`. Review the final diff as an attacker: no caller-selected run/ref/exit/reconciliation/clock/session authority, no handoff reconstruction, owner-session principal and two digest domains are not confused, request bytes are `identity.bytes`, all precommit refusals have zero residue, postcommit evidence is preserved rather than rolled back, exact replay cannot launch twice, the cross-page reader matrix executes, every generated sweep is positive, and only the three owned paths differ.

CONCENTRATED VERIFICATION, PATH-ATTRIBUTED REGRESSION, AND EXPLICIT COMMIT. Run every leg separately with its own exit code and read its output: focused Foundation service + Windows + `activation-telemetry-launch.test.ts` + `activation-run-commit.test.ts` + `provider-run-reader.test.ts` (require `Test Files 5 passed` and a test count greater than the 147-test baseline); focused `runtime-entrypoint.test.ts` plus `daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts` for plain-Node provider construction (nonzero counts); daemon typecheck; full `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (the task evidence command, nonzero count and exit 0); then repository `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm verify:foundation`, and `pnpm verify:store`, separately. For repo-wide legs, record merge-base failures before the diff and HEAD failures after it; the new failing-path set intersected with these three owned paths must be empty, and disclose foreign red verbatim without calling it green. Re-run the guarded bare-specifier positive/negative probe and confirm it deleted itself. Confirm `foundation-attempt-service.ts` <=250 lines, no debug/probe/generated evidence remains, and staged entries are only the three owned paths. Unstage any foreign path without modifying it; stage explicit paths, commit only via `git commit -- <three exact paths>`, and verify `git show --stat` contains nothing else. Completion must quote all nonzero count lines, each drill's named red, the original provider record/count preservation, and the downstream consumer id/callsite.

The edda1fd3 reader enforces principal==ownerSessionRef and will refuse every record with PROVIDER_RUN_BINDING_MISMATCH otherwise — correct fail-closed behavior that will masquerade as a reader defect to whoever hits it first. A mutation drill in edda1fd3's plan proves the check is load-bearing. Also inherit these traps: (1) duplicate-detection tests must seed duplicates ACROSS a page boundary — a first-match reader passes single-page seeds with the defect intact; (2) re-derive the aggregate id from the DECODED providerRunRef, never from the event's own stored fields (self-comparison; provider-run-contracts.ts header warns readers must compare rather than trust hash uniqueness); (3) CommandDecisionRecord is a union and NoBusinessEffectDecision carries NULL versions — discriminate on effectDisposition BEFORE any previousVersion === 0 check, since null === 0 is silently false.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: 1) Keep `createFoundationClaudeLauncher` and append telemetry afterward: rejected because that either launches twice or fabricates a handoff from a raw result. 2) Replace it with raw `launchClaudeWithTelemetry`: rejected because it bypasses the durable grant/process-registration authority. 3) Rebuild/spread `{result,handoff}` in the daemon: rejected because only the runner witnessed that they came from one capture; the adapter deliberately returns the pair by identity. 4) Use the authenticated envelope principal for the provider decision: rejected because the landed current reader requires the attempt lease's `ownerSessionRef`, deliberately distinct in real fixtures. 5) Infer clock observations from launcher ISO timestamps or use wall time: rejected; provider wall truth stays in the handoff and no boot/monotonic observation exists. 6) Persist `FoundationAttemptRecorded`/`PROCESS_OBSERVED` as exit truth: rejected by task rail; neither is physical terminal evidence. 7) Call `readCurrentProviderRun` inside the service as a second availability gate: rejected; commit already returns the durable result, tests certify the reader, and downstream task-ded026 is its real production consumer. 8) Extend the DONE reader/adapter/ledger tests or add a helper module: rejected; prerequisites already own those surfaces and the final slice is intentionally three files. 9) Treat reader failure after a successful provider commit as zero-residue: rejected as a false atomicity claim; postcommit evidence must survive, while zero residue is asserted only before commit.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Measured on moving shared-tree HEADs f96995d then d496b5e. All six prerequisites are on disk. `foundation-attempt-service.ts` is 248 lines; it currently wins RESERVED/replay fencing before an 8-line raw `createFoundationClaudeLauncher` block and then passes that raw result to `readDurableFoundationObservation`. `launchActivationProviderRun` is 143 lines, requires a separate authority, invokes public `createTelemetryBoundClaudeLauncher` once, and returns the exact `ClaudeBoundLaunchResult`. `commitActivationProviderRun` is 249 lines and commits the handoff-derived record; `readCurrentProviderRun` is 249 lines and joins the provider decision to the activation by project+attempt, verifying effect, lease epoch, and `decision.key.principalId === ownerSessionRef`. The reader suite already executes 64 real-SQLite cases including accepted, ABSENT, canonical unreadable, store unreadable, foreign binding, and a duplicate deliberately beyond the first indexed page. Provider commit and adapter suites add 16 and 34 production-surface cases. Combined current focused baseline was 5 files / 147 tests; service+Windows+reader was independently 3 files / 97 tests; daemon typecheck was exit 0 at a clean snapshot. `apps/daemon` declares both runner/store workspace dependencies and the lock importer links them. Public `discoverInstalledClaudeRuntime()` returned PROVEN on this Windows host for Claude 2.1.234, and a harmless installed `--version --model ... --effort high` invocation exited 0. Full daemon red observed during planning was foreign bridge/registry WIP outside all three owned paths; the worker must take a fresh merge-base baseline because HEAD is moving.
planningNotes.risks: The highest-risk defect is a second physical launch on replay or while trying to recover a raw result; the transparent adapter counter, provider counts, and landed adapter one-call proof must all agree. A provider decision keyed to the envelope principal will commit successfully but the strict reader will correctly refuse it as a foreign session. `identity.bytes`, reservation bytes, decision request SHA, event request SHA, and effect SHA are distinct domains; do not substitute one because lengths/digests look plausible. Blind/refused launches are valid durable UNKNOWN evidence and must be committed; they are not accepted physical exits. Conversely, `--version` proves an observed EXITED process but not a completed provider result. An unexpected adapter throw may become only the existing `FOUNDATION_ATTEMPT_LAUNCH_UNKNOWN@DAEMON_FOUNDATION_ATTEMPT`; never let it escape as a crash. The provider-commit abort occurs after activation and Foundation reservation, so zero residue is scoped to provider rows/decisions and physical invocation, not a rollback of already-authoritative activation/reservation facts. Current reader availability failures after a commit cannot erase the committed provider record. Windows handles/store must close before cleanup. Service has only two lines of target headroom, so replace and compact; do not grow DONE 249-line producers. Shared-tree baselines are volatile: no broad restore/stage/commit and no attribution of foreign registry/context work to this task.
